rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The source contains a 2025 industry allocation summary whose header is % of Investments at Fair Value and whose Total row is 100.0%, matching the platform output basis. The higher 254.1% figure appears in the SOI as Percentage of Net Assets, a different leveraged-BDC denominator. The flag therefore compares output=100 against the wrong source anchor rather than proving a data extraction error.
